title: uigetdir
summary: Open a host folder-selection dialog and return the selected folder path.
description: `uigetdir` requests a folder selection from the active RunMat filesystem provider and returns MATLAB-compatible output values. Interactive hosts can implement the provider hook to show a native or browser folder picker; noninteractive hosts return the standard cancellation value.

signatures.label: folder = uigetdir()
signatures.description: Open a folder-selection dialog using the provider's default starting folder.

signatures.label: folder = uigetdir(startPath)
signatures.description: Open a folder-selection dialog with an initial folder.

signatures.label: folder = uigetdir(startPath, title)
signatures.description: Open a folder-selection dialog with an initial folder and title.

examples.description: Prompt for a folder and list its contents unless the dialog is cancelled.
Use the current folder as the initial location and set a dialog title.

returns: `folder` is a character vector containing the selected folder path.
`folder` is `0` when the user cancels or the active noninteractive provider has no folder picker.
notes: `uigetdir` does not create, read, or list folders itself; it only returns the selected folder path.
RunMat validates malformed provider selections and reports deterministic `RunMat:uigetdir:*` errors.

errors.when: The start path or title is not a scalar text value, or too many input arguments are supplied.
More than one output argument is requested.
The active filesystem provider fails while opening the folder-selection UI.
The active filesystem provider returns an empty or otherwise malformed folder path.

gpu_residency: No. Folder-selection dialogs are host/UI operations and always execute outside GPU residency. Textual arguments are gathered before provider dispatch.
